newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner, Fokus Bank dominate Oslo share trade.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner, Fokus Bank dominate Oslo share trade.

text.p: Share trading on the Oslo bourse on Friday was dominated by construction and engineering group Kvaerner and Fokus Bank, which together accounted for more than Half of the session's bumper turnover.

Kvaerner surged more than seven percent after presenting first quarter results which beat market expectations. The London-headquartered group booked an operating profit of 442 million crowns and a pre-tax profit of 224 million crowns.
Kvaerner As advanced 25.5 crowns to 383.5 crowns, while the Bs settled 24 crowns up at 353 crowns in joint turnover of 307 million crowns.
Fokus Bank, currently locked in a takeover battle with Den norske Bank (DnB) for Trondheim-based mortgage lender BNbank, traded a huge 550 million crowns, but closed unchanged at 70 crowns.

Union Bank of Norway announced it had increased its stake in Fokus 10.28 percent in order to try and block a hostile takeover bid from Sparebankgruppen. UBN holds 1.4 percent in shares and the rest in options.
Oslo's Total share index gained a slim 0.5 percent to 1,123.14 points in turnover of 1.6 billion crowns.
